stories.title: Building a wireless network adapter for the Super Nintendo
stories.description: I built a Wi-Fi adapter for the SNES that plugs into a controller port. It syncs game saves with RetroArch and can dynamically generate in-game dialogue with an LLM.

stories.title: How should an LLM see a computer?
stories.description: We benchmarked screenshots, accessibility trees, and click-by-ID on seven OpenAI models across 172 OSWorld tasks. The tree and ID clicks more than doubled weaker models’ scores and barely moved the strongest.

stories.title: Shirudo: OpenAI and Cisco's open-source runtime for shielding unpatched Linux
stories.description: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.
